method: Deterministic center sampling of the pinned original R4 supersampled frames, followed by one opaque #191D22 contour pixel around each cell’s existing alpha coverage; no model edit or body-geometry change.

identity_source.authorship_note: Original Astra-authored tapered-canopy model. The saved model was reopened and measured without changing the approved source file.

source_frames.color_profile: All sixteen frames share the same sRGB intent 3, gAMA, and cHRM chunks; the encoder verifies and preserves those color chunks while removing per-image text/EXIF/physical-size metadata.

render.direction_meaning: Actor-facing direction, corroborated by the accepted R4 heading audit; not the viewer's camera location.

heading_audit.result: Each saved camera label matches the projected bow-minus-stern dominant axis for the saved model.

renderer.format: one 256x256 RGBA PNG atlas of sixteen 64x64 fixed cells
renderer.fixed_cell_window: Each frame is exactly its atlas cell; no per-view crop, content bounds, or rescale.
renderer.pivot_css_mapping: The 64px viewBox is placed with its 50% x / 84.375% y pivot at the canonical marker center. The sprite is an overflowing visual child; marker and health bar retain their existing geometry.
renderer.frame_css_size: 64 * bodyCssPixels / 13 / frameScale; frameScale is compensated once, as in the existing scaled-art helpers.
renderer.body_readability: R3 keeps the 64x64 windows, 32x54 ground pivot, source model and body colors while using crisp center sampling and an opaque one-pixel #191D22 contour for separation against grass and water. Actual 1x game-context captures are recorded in the R3 native-context receipt; independent visual critique remains a separate gate.
renderer.actor_facing: Uses the canonical attacker-to-target axis with vertical tie-break. Accepted src/ui/combat-state.js maps screenY = arenaLength - worldY, so +worldY selects screen-up/north; +worldX selects east. The heading audit independently confirms the saved model's north/east/south/west actor-facing labels from projected bow/stern points.
renderer.pose_selection: The existing tick-derived attack/recoil window selects the authored contact cell; all other live poses select idle. Contact names a sprite pose only and does not create a collision or projectile event.
renderer.reduced_motion: The same canonical state selects the same static cell. No frame cycling, rotation, lift, scale, or clock-driven animation is added.

encoder.reduction: select the center sample at (4x+2, 4y+2) from each 4x4 block of the pinned 256x256 source frame to make each fixed 64x64 cell
encoder.png: RGBA 8-bit, filter type 0 output rows, zlib level 9, preserves source sRGB/gAMA/cHRM, excludes text/EXIF/physical-size metadata
encoder.postprocess: add exactly one fully opaque #191D22 pixel to each transparent 8-connected neighbor of sampled alpha coverage, independently inside each 64x64 cell; preserve every nontransparent sampled RGBA pixel
